files.Title: Frontend.Runtime.Impl.GameImpl.Battle.Mode.RtsNetGameMode
files.Summary:
Online RTS (BattleUnitOwnership.md §25, server docs/rts.md): every player picks a lineup within the budget per
wave and deploys it whole; the server lays it out at one of their side's spawn points. Once all of a player's
units are gone they wait out the cooldown and deploy again. Units are ordered from the map (the offline
commander's RtsCommandController) or driven one at a time. The server owns the clock, the prices, the scores and
the outcome. A unit's last order rides its sync state, so whoever simulates it next (the host for a player who
left, the owner after a rejoin) carries it on.

files.Title: Frontend.Runtime.Impl.GameImpl.Battle.Mode.WarZoneNetGameMode
files.Summary:
War zone network game mode: the capture zone map, except a sortie is bought rather than
granted. Every price is the server's; this only shows the table it resolved. A room may let a
player keep several vehicles (BattleUnitOwnership.md §16.3 A7): while alive they buy more at the
usual price, each holding at its spawn point until driven.

files.Title: ShanghaiWindy.Core.API.RadarAPI
files.Summary:
雷达 API：读取载具雷达（地面防空雷达或机载雷达）的状态、目标与告警，并控制本地玩家自己的雷达。雷达参数在载具数据的 groundAARadarData（飞机为 radarData）里配置。联机远程副本的雷达不在本机扫描：没有目标，扫描方位不动，锁定目标与工作模式来自网络，锁定 / 模式事件不触发。
Radar API: read a vehicle's radar (ground air-defence or airborne): status, contacts and warnings, and control the local player's own radar. Radar parameters are set in the vehicle data's groundAARadarData (radarData for aircraft). A remote copy's radar does not scan on this client: no contacts, a still scan azimuth, lock target and work mode from the network, and no lock / mode events.

files.Title: ShanghaiWindy.Core.API.VehicleQuery
files.Summary:
战场载具查询：按类型、敌友、距离筛选场上存活的载具（含联机远程玩家、召唤和部署的单位），可按距离排序并限量。用 VehicleAPI.CreateQuery 建一次，反复 Run；Run 之后用 Count / Get / GetDistance 读结果。联机时只返回本队当前看得到的敌方。
Battlefield vehicle query: filters the live vehicles in the battle (remote players online, summoned and deployed units included) by kind, relation and distance, optionally sorted by distance and capped. Create it once with VehicleAPI.CreateQuery and Run it again and again; read the results with Count / Get / GetDistance after Run. Online it only returns enemies your team can currently see.
